About this room

Cozy twin-bed room featuring 2 single beds and peaceful shophouse surroundings.

Our Standard Twin Room offers air conditioning, tiled flooring, natural light, and a picturesque mural backdrop. Designed with 2 twin single beds, it is ideal for travel partners or friends who prefer separate single beds with shared bathroom facilities.

Guests have full access to our modern, spotless shared bathroom facility equipped with hot showers, hairdryers, fresh towels, slippers, and daily housekeeping.
